name: cpp-httplib
description: A C++ header-only HTTP/HTTPS server and client library

latest_release.name: v0.66.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

**Bug fixes**

- Client: a redirect now stays on the unix socket when the client uses `set_address_family(AF_UNIX)` (#2658). An absolute `Location` used to have its host taken as a socket path, so the redirect failed or went to the wrong socket. Only `localhost` (the Host this client sends) counts as the same host, so a redirect to any other host still goes through the cross-host client and drops `Authorization` and `Cookie`. A host mapped with `set_direct_hostname_addr_map` keeps its mapping, and an `https` `Location` runs TLS over the socket with the `Location`'s host.
- Server: when creating a dynamic worker thread fails (for example under a pids limit), the job now stays queued for an existing worker. The `std::system_error` used to escape the accept loop and end in `std::terminate`.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib/compare/v0.65.0...v0.66.0
